title: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law | TechCrunch
summary: Meta, Google, and TikTok have each filed lawsuits against California Attorney General Rob Bonta in an attempt to block a law that restricts social media features it deems addictive for users under 16.
